text.arabic_uthmani: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُم بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ ۖ فَمَا ٱخْتَلَفُوٓا۟ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِى بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ

words.gloss_range: coordinating opening that extends the prior grant sequence into a new evidence-and-dispute clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the ayah from starting cold. It carries the grant-list of 45:16 into a further gift before the accusation begins, so the reader hears the later dispute inside a continued benefaction frame. Its direct attachment to the following perfect verb makes the opening feel like one joined movement.

topics.headline: continued grant frame from 45:16
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears 45:17 as an extension of the 45:16 favor ledger before it becomes an indictment.
topics.reason: The opening conjunction coordinates the new giving clause with the prior context, and the boundary rows explicitly tie it to 45:16.

topics.headline: proclitic joined to the gift verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the connector and gift verb as one continuous onset rather than a detached restart.
topics.reason: The source row is form-specific and matches the local proclitic surface.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect divine giving, with the recipients marked by the attached plural object pronoun and the proofs supplied as the explicit object
words.root_gloss_range: coming, arriving, bringing, and giving; locally Form IV selects caused arrival or grant of evidence
words.prose: {{ar:ءَاتَيْنَٰهُم}} ({{tr:ʾātaynāhum}}) makes the same group recipients of a completed divine grant. The Form IV causative force makes the proofs something made to reach them, so later disagreement cannot be excused as lack of access. The verb also resumes the 45:16 grant pattern and pairs with the later coming of knowledge, doubling the arrival-to-them pressure before their rivalry is named.

topics.headline: completed grant to the same recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the later blamed group as the very group that had received the clarifying gift.
topics.reason: The aligned verb is a perfect with a third-plural object suffix, and the explicit object follows as the thing granted.

topics.headline: Form IV made-to-reach evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the evidence as deliberately delivered, not merely available somewhere nearby.
topics.reason: The broad root includes coming and arrival, while the local Form IV giving frame narrows that field to caused arrival as grant.

topics.headline: grant in 45:16 continued and doubled by knowledge arrival
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks a repeated access motif: they are given proofs and then knowledge comes to them.
topics.reason: Rows connect the verb to 45:16 and to the later arrival verb in the same ayah.

topics.headline: completed grant precedes completed dispute
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the syntax makes disagreement a response after disclosure, not a search before it.
topics.reason: The giving clause precedes the fa-marked disagreement clause in the local clause sequence.

words.gloss_range: indefinite plural clear proofs, the explicit object of the giving verb and the first point in the ayah's clarity-to-division chain
words.root_gloss_range: clarifying, making manifest, separating, and between-ness; locally the sign/proof branch is selected while the separation pressure remains thematically active

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: repeated between-them phrase in the rivalry and judgment clauses

words.prose: {{ar:بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ}} ({{tr:bayyinātin}}) names the gift as multiple manifest proofs, not a single fragile hint. Together with definite knowledge, it squeezes out an innocent-confusion reading, like the warning against division after clear proofs in 3:105. The root's clarifying and separating field gives the word its irony: what should make truth distinct becomes followed by social division among the recipients. Its placement before the fa-marked dispute lets evidence testify first, while the later {{ar:بَيْنَهُمْ}} ({{tr:baynahum}}) phrases turn the same root-family from proof into between-space and judgment-space. Its marked indefinite sound is later answered by the marked motive noun, tightening the irony from clear signs to rivalry.

topics.headline: multiple clear proofs as the granted object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the dispute set against abundant clear evidence rather than against ambiguity.
topics.reason: The word is an indefinite feminine plural object of the giving verb, locally selecting the clear-proof sense.

topics.headline: proofs paired with definite knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels innocent confusion squeezed out by the pairing of manifest proofs and knowledge, a warning pattern also seen in 3:105.
topics.reason: Rows link the local proof plural with the later knowledge noun and with the post-proof division pattern in 3:105.

topics.headline: clarity root turns into between-space
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony that the root of clarification also frames the social interval later corrupted and judged.
topics.reason: The local lexical sense remains clear proofs, while the repeated b-y-n forms license a thematic, not translational, root-chain payoff.

topics.headline: evidence stands before the dispute report

topics.reason: Local syntax places the proof object and its source-domain before the fa-marked disagreement.

Whether heard as source, domain, or partitive shading, the particle anchors the evidence in an authoritative command-affair before disagreement is narrated. The tight nasal transition keeps the proof phrase and its source-domain audibly welded.

words.gloss_range: definite command-affair, the authoritative domain from which the clear proofs are given
words.root_gloss_range: commanding, ordering, affair, case, and decisive matter; locally the definite noun combines normative command and disclosed affair
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَمْرِ}} ({{tr:al-amri}}) makes the evidence belong to a definite authoritative matter, not an undefined subject. Its command-and-affair range lets the disputed matter carry normative weight, which is why later conflict is grave. The same phrase returns in 45:18 as the ground for a prescribed way, and the ayah's own movement carries the disclosed command-affair toward the Lord's final adjudication.

words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the ayah's sharp hinge from gift to accusation. After proofs from the command-affair have been stated, the particle makes the disagreement feel like a morally charged aftermath rather than a neutral later event. Its short fa-mā onset interrupts the longer gift register, and the next human response after clear signs is restricted disagreement rather than gratitude. Its attachment to {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) fuses the turn with the negated restriction.

topics.headline: pivot from evidence to indictment

topics.headline: next human act is restricted dispute

preceding result particle joined to this negation

That frame excludes softer explanations and makes the timing after knowledge carry the interpretive burden. Joined with {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}), it makes the turn from gift to indictment compact and severe.

words.gloss_range: Form VIII perfect plural intransitive disagreement, foregrounding mutual divergence before the disputed domain is specified later
words.root_gloss_range: coming after, succeeding, being behind, differing, and opposing; locally Form VIII selects reciprocal divergence with post-knowledge afterness active
words.prose: {{ar:ٱخْتَلَفُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:ikhtalafū}}) first reports the split without naming an object, so the act of division itself comes forward before the motive is disclosed. Form VIII makes the divergence mutual within the group, not the act of one isolated dissenter. The root's afterness and opposition fit the surrounding after-knowledge frame, and the post-knowledge rivalry diagnosis matches the pattern in 42:14 while 45:17 moves on to scheduled judgment. The same dispute root returns at the end as ongoing habit under divine judgment, bracketing the human side with a repeated harsh root texture.

The small doubled particle carries the major logical load of excluding softer explanations.

words.root_gloss_range: distance, remoteness, after-ness, and separation; locally the temporal after sense is selected with moral distance activated by context
words.prose: {{ar:بَعْدِ}} ({{tr:baʿdi}}) governs the clause of knowledge's coming, so the reference point is not an abstract time but the event of arrival itself. Its distance field turns chronology into moral remoteness: they move away after proximity to knowledge. Inside the exclusive frame, this after-knowledge timing becomes the core of the accusation, echoing the same formulaic pressure seen in 3:19. Explicit afterness also reinforces the dispute root's behind/opposition pressure, while the heavy b-sounds carry the indictment from afterness into rivalry.

words.prose: {{ar:جَآءَهُمُ}} ({{tr:jāʾahumu}}) dramatizes arrival before the subject is named, and its stretched sound gives the arrival verb prominence inside the temporal indictment. Knowledge comes to them; they are recipients of the event, not authors of it, so knowledge confronts them rather than remaining generally available. That active arrival pairs with the earlier gift verb, so the ayah doubles the access motif before the motive of rivalry appears. The post-knowledge rivalry formula also recalls 3:19, now embedded in a wider proof-to-judgment structure.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعِلْمُ}} ({{tr:al-ʿilmu}}) is the definite subject that came to them, not vague information. Together with the earlier clear proofs, it forms an epistemic doublet that removes the space for innocent confusion and joins the community-test pattern of post-message dispute in 2:213. Placed just before {{ar:بَغْيًۢا}} ({{tr:baghyan}}), it turns epistemic privilege into moral exposure. Within the surah, 45:17's received knowledge contrasts with the no-knowledge claim in 45:24, so the word belongs to a wider axis of disclosed knowledge against speculation.

words.prose: {{ar:بَغْيًۢا}} ({{tr:baghyan}}) names the inner drive of the dispute. The accusative verbal noun makes rivalry or transgressive seeking the motive or state behind the split, not a principled search for truth. Coming after knowledge and before divine judgment, it becomes the moral hinge of the ayah; the shared phrase in 42:14 confirms this post-knowledge rivalry diagnosis. Its marked indefinite form answers the earlier marked proof phrase, while the following between-them phrase localizes that rivalry inside the community.

The relation-space where clarity should have operated becomes the place where rivalry spreads. Because the phrase returns with judgment, the ayah turns one social interval from human rivalry into the site of divine adjudication. The b-y-n chain runs from disclosed clarity to social fracture to final separation, and the sound of the motive-plus-community phrase binds the charge together.

The matter disclosed at the front is not abandoned; it is carried to adjudication on the Day of Rising, unlike the immediate decree scene in 2:117. The same phrase that earlier hosted rivalry is now reclaimed as the place of settlement, tying the motive clause directly to the judgment clause by exact recurrence. In the b-y-n chain, the God who gave clear proofs distinguishes between the disputants, and the phrase resonates with settlement language such as 10:93, where Israelite dispute is also placed before final judgment. Its hum ending flows into the Day marker so the time of judgment does not detach from the parties judged.

words.prose: {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kānū}}) turns the final disagreement into a maintained past condition. With the following imperfect, it presents their differing as ongoing habit, not a single lapse, while the action remains internally unfinished. The coda therefore judges a whole pattern: the opening perfects give completed grant and outbreak, while this auxiliary recasts the dispute as a sustained state. It also joins the surah's concern with what people used to do, including the archived deeds of 45:29, and its long-vowel cadence lets the final charge linger.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ayah sequences a gift of clarity, the arrival of knowledge, divergence driven by transgression, and a later judgment.
baseline_models.mechanism: Clarity and knowledge remove simple informational lack as the main cause. Transgressive rivalry supplies the motive that turns a shared disclosure into divergent paths, while final judgment answers that motivated split.

activation_trace.role: The giving branch supplies an actual grant and makes clarity something delivered rather than privately discovered.
The disclosure branch anchors the initial clarity and keeps visibility active across the repeated root.
The knowing branch supplies attained recognition and rules out bare ignorance as the whole explanation.
The overstepping branch supplies the social motive that pushes difference beyond a neutral plurality.
The divergent-path branch gives both disagreement verbs their active separation mechanism.
The decisive-judgment branch supplies the eventual resolution of claims that human rivalry cannot settle.

changed_reading.before: The parties differed because the evidence or knowledge available to them was inadequate.
changed_reading.after: They split after clarity and knowledge had arrived; rivalry and overstepping, not mere ambiguity, drive the divergence that judgment will expose.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: One root marks the clear things and twice marks the space between the parties.
baseline_models.mechanism: The lexical recurrence makes disclosure relational. What is made clear enters a shared connective space; transgression strains that space into separation, and divine judgment returns to the same between to distinguish the parties.

activation_trace.role: The appearing branch supplies public clarity as the initial condition of the relation.
The connective branch supplies a bond or shared field that can be preserved or damaged between parties.
The separation branch supplies the fracture latent in the same relational root.
The transgression branch functions as the force converting relation into rupture.
The adjudication branch re-enters the disputed social space to distinguish claims.

changed_reading.before: Clear evidence and interpersonal dispute are separate topics in successive clauses.
changed_reading.after: Clarity is placed inside the parties' shared relational field; the tragedy is that the very between capable of disclosure and connection becomes the site of rupture and judgment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A granted matter or command is followed by contested difference and the Lord's decisive ruling.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah can be read as an entrusted order whose recipients turn stewardship into rival jurisdiction. The closing Lord-and-judgment construction reserves ultimate authority after the human contest.

activation_trace.role: The grant branch supplies an entrusted endowment rather than an accidental possession.
The authority branch lets the matter carry a jurisdictional dimension that recipients may contest.
The deliberation branch supplies the legitimate management of judgment that rivalry can deform.
The sovereignty branch identifies the authority that remains above factional claims.
The cutting judgment branch supplies final jurisdiction over the contested order.
The momentous-event branch marks a reserved occasion when that jurisdiction becomes effective.

changed_reading.before: The ayah reports a doctrinal disagreement followed by punishment.
changed_reading.after: It also stages a failed stewardship: recipients contest an entrusted order, but their rival jurisdictions remain subordinate to the Lord's final ruling.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction places divergence after an arrival and postpones its completion to a named future event.
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowledge's arrival creates an irreversible before-and-after threshold. Repeated disagreement occupies the interval between that arrival and the event at which adjudication completes what history leaves open.

activation_trace.role: The subsequent-time branch establishes a strict threshold after the prior arrival.
The arrival branch makes knowledge an event entering history rather than a timeless possession.
The recognition branch supplies the threshold's epistemic content.
The completion branch frames judgment as bringing an unfinished interval to its end.
The eventful-day branch supplies the terminal horizon of the interval.
The resurrection branch identifies that horizon as the standing and raising of creation.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes a static disagreement and an unrelated future verdict.
changed_reading.after: It maps a temporal arc: knowledge arrives, motivated divergence persists through an open historical interval, and judgment finally completes that interval.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier context presents alternation and redirected movement as ordered signs. Against that background, the focus does not condemn difference as such; it marks a specifically human divergence made culpable by its post-knowledge, transgressive motive.

activation_trace.role: The separate-path branch supplies the focus's contested divergence.
The overstepping branch supplies the moral discriminator attached to human difference.
The alternating-succession branch supplies a noncompetitive difference in which one phase follows another.
The state-to-state turning branch makes variation an intelligible ordered process rather than a fault.
The alternation branch supplies the winds' reciprocal movement as a productive counterpart to factional divergence.

structural_cues: 45:5 coordinates night-day alternation, redirected winds, signs, and reasoning in one positive sequence.
45:17 adds both the after-knowledge threshold and the explicit transgressive motive to its disagreement verbs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one ordered natural alternation and one transgressively motivated human divergence; I infer that motive, not plurality itself, flips the valuation. A live alternative is that the shared root is ordinary polysemy without a deliberate contrast.

changed_reading.before: Difference itself is the failure named by the focus.
changed_reading.after: Difference can be sign-bearing and generative; the failure is rivalry-driven divergence after knowledge, a disordering of difference rather than difference alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context contrasts two modes of pursuit. Seeking can move within a commanded, serviceable course toward bounty, while desire-led following after a disclosed way turns pursuit into overreach and sends parties onto competing routes.

activation_trace.role: The directive branch supplies an order within which movement can be governed.
The boundary-crossing branch marks pursuit that has escaped its legitimate limit.
The different-route branch supplies the resulting split in course.
The directed-service branch supplies an environment made tractable for a purpose.
The flowing-movement branch supplies travel that proceeds through the governed medium.
The vessel branch gives the governed movement a concrete carrier and course.
The directive branch explicitly places the vessel's movement under command.
The seeking branch supplies a legitimate pursuit of bounty and exposes the focus root's morally open base.
The entering-an-undertaking branch supplies a disclosed way in which the addressee is placed.
The following branch makes course choice an enacted attachment rather than an abstract opinion.
The inward-inclination branch supplies the competing guide that redirects following away from the disclosed course.

structural_cues: 45:12 places vessel movement by command beside seeking bounty.
45:18 immediately follows the focus with a disclosed way, two opposed acts of following, and desires as the rival object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies governed travel, legitimate seeking, a disclosed undertaking, and opposed following; I infer a course-selection analogy for the focus's divergent paths. The live alternative is a simpler ethical contrast between permitted and transgressive seeking with no sustained navigation model.

changed_reading.before: The focus's transgression is generic aggression among people who disagree.
changed_reading.after: It is also misdirected pursuit: seeking that could travel under the given order instead follows desire, crosses its limit, and fractures a common course into rival routes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding grant list turns the focus's clear matters into the continuation of a concrete inheritance: inscription, judgment, prophetic communication, provision, and distinction. Disagreement therefore concerns the stewardship of an ordered communal endowment, not propositions alone.

activation_trace.role: The giving branch carries the preceding endowment syntax into the focus.
The manifest branch makes the inherited order publicly legible rather than merely possessed.
The authority branch lets the inherited package carry institutions and jurisdiction.
The repeated grant branch directly links the list of endowments to the focus's opening action.
The binding-inscription branch supplies a norm that establishes obligation or determination.
The adjudication branch supplies an institutional capacity for deciding among people.
The prophetic-report branch supplies an authorized channel by which the order is communicated.
The apportioned-gift branch adds material provision to the entrusted communal package.
The benefaction branch frames distinction as bestowed favor rather than self-generated superiority.

structural_cues: 45:16 immediately precedes the focus and opens with the same first-person plural act of giving.
The grant list moves from text and judgment through prophecy and provision before the focus compresses the continuation into clear matters.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, repeated giving, and a concrete grant list; I infer that the focus resumes and condenses that inheritance. A live alternative is that the clear matters are a narrower subsequent gift not coextensive with the full list.

changed_reading.before: The clear things are abstract evidence offered to isolated knowers.
changed_reading.after: They belong to a public institutional inheritance whose text, judgment, communication, provision, and status require stewardship; rivalry corrupts that entrusted order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context supplies a feedback loop rather than a single bad choice: signs are understood, proud persistence resists them, desire becomes the followed authority, and sensory-cognitive access is then sealed. Knowledge and distortion can coexist because motive governs uptake and reproduces its own closure.

activation_trace.role: The recognition branch supplies real epistemic contact before the split.
The overstepping branch supplies motive as the force that governs what happens after contact.
The divergent-route branch supplies the durable social and interpretive split produced by that motive.
The understanding-and-compliance branch makes hearing a possible uptake that the verse's behavior refuses.
The determined-persistence branch supplies active continuation after exposure rather than passive unawareness.
The pride branch supplies the posture that converts exposure into resistance.
The following branch supplies the practical mechanism by which one guide is chosen over another.
The desire branch supplies an inward inclination that competes with the disclosed order.
The same inclination branch is elevated into the person's governing object, intensifying motive into authority.
The loss-of-course branch supplies the resulting deviation from guidance and aim.
The knowing branch keeps real knowledge present inside the later scene of deviation.
The securing-seal branch supplies a closure that prevents renewed access.
The covering branch supplies obscured perception as the loop's visible endpoint.

structural_cues: 45:8 sequences hearing, recitation, persistence, pride, and acting as though no hearing occurred.
45:18 opposes following the disclosed way to following desires, while 45:23 places desire, knowledge, sealing, and covering in one construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated exposure, persistence, desire as governing object, knowledge, and sealed faculties; I infer a recursive causal loop in which motivated refusal hardens later access. A live alternative is that the seal is an externally imposed consequence without a psychologically recursive mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The parties possess knowledge and then simply choose to disagree despite it.
changed_reading.after: Their post-knowledge rivalry can become self-maintaining: desire governs uptake, proud persistence rejects what was heard, and repeated refusal closes the faculties through which correction could arrive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to forgive before the focus and the return to the Lord reserve final settlement to divine judgment. The focus's future ruling therefore limits factional retaliation in the present as well as promising eventual decision.

activation_trace.role: The decisive-ruling branch supplies the jurisdiction explicitly reserved for the Lord.
The sovereign branch identifies who holds that jurisdiction.
The appointed event branch defers the conclusive ruling beyond present factional conflict.
The protective-covering branch supplies a present response that withholds the sin's retaliatory effect.
The momentous-days branch supplies the future horizon not expected by the opposing group.
The recompense branch transfers proportional response from present grievance to later accounting.
The sovereign branch places the return under the same authority named in the focus.
The return branch supplies the movement by which all parties reach the reserved forum.

structural_cues: 45:14 gives believers an imperative to forgive and assigns recompense elsewhere.
45:15 closes with return to the Lord immediately before the grant history and the focus's judgment clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies present forgiveness, future recompense, return, and the Lord's later ruling; I infer a jurisdictional allocation that restrains present retaliation. A live alternative is that the forgiveness command is locally bounded and does not define the function of the focus's judgment clause generally.

changed_reading.before: The final judgment clause mainly threatens the disputants.
changed_reading.after: It also disciplines the audience: present factions are not licensed to enact the final verdict, because forgiveness now and adjudication later belong to different jurisdictions.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby alliance statement makes the focus's between a network, not an empty gap. Transgressive disagreement can fracture one relation while producing tight factional proximity and mutual support inside another; final judgment cuts across those partial alignments.

activation_trace.role: The connective branch supplies the social bonds occupying the space between parties.
The separation branch supplies fracture within that same social field.
The transgression branch makes coalition and fracture morally charged uses of relation.
The withholding-from-right branch supplies the unjust orientation shared by the allied parties.
The partition branch supplies factional parts that relate to and reinforce one another.
The no-gap proximity branch supplies the tight adjacency that can coexist with wider division.
The support-and-allegiance branch supplies the active coalition structure contrasted within the verse.

structural_cues: 45:17 repeats the relational locator around both transgression and judgment.
45:19 repeats 'some' on both sides of an alliance relation and contrasts that network with divine patronage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated between and a nearby part-to-part alliance; I infer that disagreement reorganizes social proximity rather than merely separating individuals. A live alternative is that 45:19 describes a different group relation with no backward effect on the focus.

changed_reading.before: Disagreement is a set of individual opinions moving apart.
changed_reading.after: It is a topology of faction formation: the shared field breaks at one scale while unjust parties become close allies at another, all beneath a judgment that is not captured by their networks.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later context unfolds the focus's compact judgment into a procedure: false equivalence is rejected, agents are recompensed, all are gathered and summoned, and a copied record speaks through their acts. The disputed matter is resolved by public evidence and differentiated accountability, not an unexplained decree.

activation_trace.role: The decisive-adjudication branch supplies the compact ruling later expanded into a procedure.
The resurrection branch supplies the standing forum in which the procedure occurs.
The judgment branch supplies a criticized human ruling that the later procedure corrects.
The equality branch supplies the false leveling that differentiated judgment rejects.
The act-for-consequence branch supplies proportional accountability for each self.
The gathering branch supplies the assembly of formerly scattered parties into one forum.
The kneeling branch supplies the parties' embodied posture before the forum.
The calling branch supplies formal summons into the adjudicative process.
The registry branch supplies a record associated with each community and its membership.
The speaking-indication branch makes the record function as articulating evidence.
The copying branch supplies faithful transfer of acts into the evidentiary record.
The intentional-action branch supplies the conduct that the record preserves and judgment evaluates.

structural_cues: 45:21-22 contrast a bad equality judgment with individual recompense and no injustice.
45:26-29 sequence gathering, kneeling, summons, community records, speaking evidence, copying, and deeds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered forensic sequence; I infer that it expands the focus's brief promise of judgment and that deeds test the parties' rival claims. A live alternative is that the later record concerns conduct generally rather than the specific disputed content.

changed_reading.before: The Lord will settle the disputed propositions by an opaque final verdict.
changed_reading.after: The ruling is pictured as public evidentiary adjudication: parties are gathered, false equivalence is refused, records articulate their acts, and accountability distinguishes what rivalry had confused.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated clarity root links initial disclosure, contested proof, and manifest outcome. What parties try to convert into adversarial argument remains legible, speaks through the record, and finally appears as consequence surrounding them.

activation_trace.role: The appearing branch supplies the focus's initial public visibility.
The same appearing branch carries clarity into an explicitly adversarial response scene.
The prevailing-proof branch supplies the disputants' attempt to answer disclosure with a counterclaim.
The articulate-indication branch turns preserved conduct into legible testimony.
The success-and-deliverance branch supplies the positive outcome later described as manifest.
The appearing branch makes the outcome openly visible, echoing the focus's initial clarity.
The emergence branch supplies the unveiling of what conduct had produced.
The descending-and-encircling branch makes disclosed consequence inescapably surround its agents.

structural_cues: The same clarity root appears in the focus, the later recitation-and-argument scene, and the description of manifest success.
45:29-33 moves from a speaking record to the appearance and enclosure of the agents' own bad acts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated visibility language and an ordered unveiling sequence; I infer a disclosure-to-consequence arc in which rejected clarity returns as evidence. A live alternative is that the repeated clarity terms independently modify signs and success without forming one arc.

changed_reading.before: Clarity belongs only to a past revelation that the parties left behind when they disputed.
changed_reading.after: Clarity persists across the whole process: it is first given, then contested, then made articulate in the record, and finally manifested as differentiated consequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates material channel, rainfall, marker, passage, vessel, and water-source branches far from the ordinary forms. It remains anchored in the focus's giving, matter, knowledge, seeking, and divergence sequence and is reinforced by the nearby governed sea-course and disclosed-way scenes. Downstream prose should present it only as a branch-induced spatial analogy, never as the lexical translation or exclusive sense of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus moves from delivery and guidance-bearing knowledge to excessive seeking, divergent passage, and a later appointed settlement.

activation_trace.role: The water-channel branch supplies a material analogy in which a delivered order is directed through a usable course.
The route-marker branch supplies knowledge as something that makes direction recognizable.
The marker-and-appointment branch supplies both orientation and a fixed horizon for the course.
The passage branch supplies a route through terrain and lets divergence be imagined as competing channels.
The excessive-rain branch supplies overflow as a material analogy for pursuit exceeding its proper measure.
The broad-water branch supplies the shared medium through which a governed course can run.
The flowing branch supplies unobstructed movement through that medium.
The vessel branch supplies a carrier whose successful travel depends on staying within the given course.
The visible-water-source branch supplies an accessible point from which a common normative course can begin.

changed_reading.before: The ayah contains only abstract evidence, motives, and opinions.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can be spatialized as a guidance system: a channel and markers are supplied, excessive pursuit overflows the measure, routes split, and the appointed judgment reveals where the courses led.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates succession and replacement beneath a verbal form whose direct sense is disagreement. It remains anchored in the focus's repeated divergence root, its explicit after-threshold, and its past-duration construction, while later copying and lineage branches provide a mechanism for transmission. Downstream prose should qualify it as a possible diachronic layer of the dispute, not substitute it for contemporaneous disagreement.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus repeats divergence across a temporal interval opened after knowledge arrived and remembered at the final judgment.

activation_trace.role: The replacement branch supplies one cohort or position coming after another and occupying its place.
The subsequent-time branch supplies the threshold from which transmission can unfold.
The past-occurrence branch supplies durable historical states later recalled in judgment.
The lineage branch supplies a community whose received order can pass through generations.
The successive-replacement branch supplies diachronic sequence in which one layer follows another.
The written-record branch supplies an archive that preserves rather than erases successive conduct.
The intentional-action branch supplies what each successive layer contributes to the record.

changed_reading.before: The focus concerns one contemporaneous dispute among a single set of recipients.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the disagreement may also propagate by succession: later cohorts inherit and replace earlier positions, while the record copies each layer's acts for final adjudication.

strongest_changes: The natural alternation in 45:5 separates productive difference from rivalry-driven post-knowledge divergence.
The repeated seeking and command roots in 45:12, followed by disclosed way versus desire in 45:18, recast transgression as a failure of governed pursuit and course choice.
The sequence from 45:21 through 45:29 expands final judgment into differentiated, record-based public adjudication.
The hearing, persistence, desire, knowledge, seal, and covering sequence makes post-knowledge disagreement a self-reinforcing closure rather than a one-time choice.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's triple use of one root for clarity and the space between parties generated a relational reading, while surrounding contexts repeatedly opposed constructive and destructive realizations of the same roots. Branch-distant route, water, and copying images then exposed coherent but explicitly exploratory spatial and diachronic models that a conservative synthesis would likely suppress.
remaining_uncertainties: The matter root can remain a general affair, a directive, or a jurisdictional order; the packet keeps all three scopes live.
The relational force of the repeated clarity/between root may be deliberate wordplay or ordinary recurrence.
The course and hydraulic models are coherent across several branches but remain form-distant analogies rather than direct lexical readings.
The archival-succession model may describe generational propagation, or the succession branches may only illuminate the record sequence without changing the focus's contemporaneous dispute.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Clarity becomes a boundary people weaponize.** `ب ي ن/B001` is separation after connection, `خ ل ف/B004` has each party take a different way, and `ب غ ي/B001` is seeking. The packet repeats `بين` around evidence, rivalry, and judgment. I infer that the supplied clarifications created distinguishable positions, while rival seeking converted distinction into social separation. The ayah reads not as knowledge failing to clarify but as clarified boundaries being recruited into competition.
2. **Judgment cuts the loop of divergence.** `ق ض ي/B001` is a decisive ruling, while `خ ل ف/B004` appears at both the historical rupture and its future object. The packet supplies the loop; I infer that judgment terminates what factional repetition cannot. The final ruling does not merely select a side but closes an endlessly self-renewing process of taking contrary paths.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 45:18's singular visible way and prohibition of following desires identifies the practical correction to the divergence described here.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Clarity is converted into the interval of division, then closed by judgment.** Lexical anchors: appearance/clarity in `ب ي ن B004` for `بَيِّنَٰت`, the interval between parties in `ب ي ن B002` for repeated `بَيْنَهُمْ`, path-divergence in `خ ل ف B004`, and decisive ruling in `ق ض ي B001`. The packet supplies one coordinated whole in 45:13 and a single visible channel in 45:18. I infer clear common matter -> competitive overstepping -> social gap -> decisive closure. The ayah diagnoses disagreement as a transformation of shared clarity, not its absence.
2. **Exploratory: rivalry behaves like a wound spreading through the social middle.** Lexical anchor: the accepted wound-spreading variant `ب غ ي B004` in `بَغْيًا`; the bodily wound of `ج ر ح B001` appears in 45:21 alongside acquired acts in `ج ر ح B002`. The packet also repeats `بَيْنَهُمْ`, locating the damage between parties. I infer overstepping -> lesion in the relational interval -> proliferating divergence. The weak link is the transfer from bodily corruption to social structure, but the later wound-root makes that dormant material image newly visible.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 45:21 was the strongest later surprise: `ٱجْتَرَحُوا` supplied the explicit wound-root that activated the wound-spreading scope of `ب غ ي B004`. 45:18 also converted abstract disagreement into departure from a single visible, trackable access.

baseline.text: Onlara bu işe ilişkin açık kanıtlar verdik. Onlar, kendilerine bilgi geldikten sonra yalnızca aralarındaki taşkınlık yüzünden ayrılığa düştüler. Rabbin, ayrılığa düştükleri konuda kıyamet günü aralarında hüküm verecektir.

findings.text: Açık kanıtlar ortak meseleyi belirginleştirmişken rekabet, bu ayrımları taraflar arasındaki toplumsal mesafeye dönüştürür; ayrılık bilginin yokluğundan değil, açıklığın araç edilmesinden doğar.
Son hüküm, tarafların sürekli karşıt yollar üretmesiyle yenilenen ayrılık döngüsünü kesin bir kararla kapatır.
Aralarındaki taşkınlık, toplumsal orta alanda açılıp ayrılığı çoğaltan bedensel bir yara gibi işliyor olabilir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Knowledge presents a traversable route, while following, divergence, transgression, and desire determine where the traveler ends.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Law becomes a public watering approach, prophecy a clear road, disagreement a physical fork, and desire an empty medium that tips the follower into a fall.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Law Opens as a Watering Route
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A clear road brings travelers to an open water source; entering it and following its traces sustains directed movement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: public approach to water (`quranic:root_000789:B002/m01`); entering and undertaking an affair (`quranic:root_000789:B003/m01`); following a person, order, or trace (`quranic:root_000175:B001/m01`); tracing an imprint step by step (`quranic:root_000175:B003/m01`); prophecy as a clear road (`quranic:root_001464:B007/m01`); gentle guidance to a path (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`); binding command (`quranic:root_000051:B002/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: `شريعة` supplies the setting and access point, prophecy supplies the road, command supplies direction, and following supplies locomotion. The legal image is therefore a maintained approach to life-giving access rather than an abstract rule set.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Knowledge presents a traversable route, while following, divergence, transgression, and desire determine where the traveler ends.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Law becomes a public watering approach, prophecy a clear road, disagreement a physical fork, and desire an empty medium that tips the follower into a fall.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Knowledge Forks Into Rival Paths
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Clear evidence arrives, but participants leave a shared course, cross proper limits, and await a verdict that cuts through their divergence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: disclosure as clear proof (`quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`); knowledge disclosed to the knower (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`); each party taking a different path (`quranic:root_000433:B004/m01`); transgressive crossing of a limit (`quranic:root_000138:B003/m01`); decisive judgment (`quranic:root_001237:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The problem is not absence of a route but branching after disclosure. Divergence gives the spatial operation, transgression explains the crossing, and judgment is the terminal act that resolves the fork.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Intended action creates an attributable entry that can be claimed, compared, judged, and reciprocally settled.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Wrongdoing is both acquisition and incision, equality is a disputed valuation, and the self is the legal identity to which the resulting account returns.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Contested Proof Awaits a Cutting Judgment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Clear evidence enters a dispute, speakers advance a purported proof and truth claim, and a final judgment separates valid assertion from performance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: disclosed evidence (`quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`); prevailing proof in dispute (`quranic:root_000295:B003/m01`); truthful assertion (`quranic:root_000852:B001/m01`); fulfillment that verifies a claim (`quranic:root_000852:B004/m01`); articulated statement (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`); decisive judgment (`quranic:root_001237:B001/m01`); truth fixed to reality (`quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The demand to produce the fathers is a courtroom maneuver: statement claims the status of proof, while truth requires enacted verification. The earlier decisive judgment supplies the terminal operation that the argument itself cannot perform.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Life persists through generation, vital embodiment, and regathering despite the claim that time merely extinguishes successive bodies.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The resurrection dispute is pressured by a full generative chain of lineage, womb, childbirth, parenthood, loss, arrival, and collection.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Womb, Lineage, and Fathers Form a Generative Chain
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Lineage is built through a womb, childbirth, paternal nurture, arrival, and loss; the demand for the fathers points back into this material chain.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: sons and transmitted lineage (`quranic:root_000156:B007/m01`); womb as the child's enclosure (`quranic:root_000552:B003/m01`); childbirth and the newborn (`quranic:root_001533:B005/m01`); fatherhood and nurture (`quranic:root_000007:B001/m01`); arrival into presence (`quranic:root_000009:B001/m01`); bringing or presenting another (`quranic:root_000009:B002/m01`); a parent's loss of a child (`quranic:root_001454:B005/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The lexical field renders ancestry as embodied production rather than an inert list of predecessors. Asking that fathers be brought back invokes arrival at the far end of a process whose earlier stages already include enclosing, birthing, nurturing, and bereavement.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalın çekirdeğini gelme ve ulaşma olarak doğrular; kolaylık niteliği açıklamalardan yalnız birinde belirgindir. Gelmeyi isteme ise dalın genel anlamı değil, ayrı bir kalıpta görülen kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek anlam gelme ve ulaşmadır; gelmeyi isteme yalnız ilgili kalıba bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın gelme anlamı ile birini gecikmiş sayıp gelmesini istemeyi bildiren kalıp birbirine karıştırılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin ya da şeyin bulunduğu yere gelmesi veya bir hedefe ulaşmasıdır; bazı kullanımlarda bu gelişin kolayca gerçekleştiği belirtilir.

facets.statement: Bir kişi ya da şey gelir veya bir hedefe ulaşır.
Bir açıklamada gelişin kolaylıkla gerçekleşmesi özellikle belirtilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gelme ve ulaşma çekirdeğinde birleşir; kolaylık, çekirdeği sınırlamayan ek bir niteleme olarak görünür.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişi veya şeyin bir yere gelişi ya da hedefe varışı anlatılırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gelme ve bir hedefe ulaşma çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin başka bir kişinin bulunduğu yere gelişi söz konusu olduğunda doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin bir hedefe doğru gelip ulaşmasını korur.

error_profile.preserves: Büyük mesafe, açıklık ve uzaklık çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki taraf arasındaki mesafenin büyüklüğünü anlatan cümlelerde doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Taraflar arası büyük uzaklık fikrini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal uzaklık durumunu genel bir mesafe ve açıklık olarak verir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal iki şeyin birbirinden ne kadar uzak olduğunu haber verme kalıbına daha bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da iki şey arasındaki büyük uzaklık alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal uzak mesafe niteliğini isimsel olarak kurar; komşu dal uzaklığın bildirilmesi ve uyumsuzluk hissiyle kullanılabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal iki uç arasında açıklık veya aralık mesafesi kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yakın olmama durumunu genel mekansal veya soyut uzaklık olarak anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yakın olmama ve mesafe alanını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal aradaki mesafenin genişliğini öne çıkarır; komşu dal uzaklık durumunu daha genel tutar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal mesafe ve açıklığın büyüklüğüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ayrılıp kopma olayını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ayrılma sonucunda uzak mesafe ortaya çıkabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal son durumda ölçülen uzaklığı verir; komşu dal uzaklığı doğurabilen ayrılma veya kopma olayını verir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; yayımlanan sınırlar uzaklık, genel mesafe ve ayrılma sonucuyla ilgilidir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البعد بين طرفين، والبئر البعيدة القعر أو الواسعة التي يبعد ما بين شفيرها وقعرها.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه البون بمعنى الفضل والمزية إذا غلبت عليه الواو، ولا مجرد الفراق بلا دلالة بعد.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو بعد الشيء (maqayis)؛ البائنة البئر البعيدة القعر الواسعة (sihah)؛ بيون لبعد ما بين الشفير والقعر (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi toprağın göz erimine kadar uzanan parçası, yönü veya yüksekçe kalın bölgesi olarak dar bir arazi adını verir. Geçici çerçeve yer adlarını ve sırf ara-konumu dışarıda tuttuğu için uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yalın dal arazi parçası veya yönüyle sınırlıdır; iki şey arasındaki genel aralık değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam yalındır; tanım özel ad veya kalıp değil, arazi parçası anlamını verir.

concept_map.definition: Gözün uzanabildiği ölçüde görülen bir arazi parçası, tarafı, yöresi veya yer yer kabarık bölgesidir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam göz erimine kadar uzanan bir arazi parçasıdır.
Bazı anlatımlar bunu arazi yönü, bölgesi veya kabarık sert kesimi olarak verir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar arazi parçası çekirdeğinde birleşir; anlatımlar bu parçayı göz erimi, yön veya kabarık yer parçası olarak değişik açılardan tarif eder.

concept_gloss.applicability: Gözle seçilebilen genişlikte bir yer kesimi veya yöre anlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Arazi parçası, yöre ve göz erimi sınırını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gözle görülebilen yer parçası veya yöre anlamındaki akıcı kullanımlar için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yer parçası ve bölge niteliğini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: göz erimindeki arazi parçası, yöre veya kabarık yer

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal göz erimiyle ölçülen arazi kesimi veya yön olarak tarif edilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yanındakinden ayrışan leke, parça veya yer kesimi fikrini taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da arazide seçilen bir kesimi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal göz erimi ve yöre ölçüsünü vurgular; komşu dal seçilebilir parça veya leke niteliğini öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal belirli bir arazi kesimi, yönü veya kabarık parçasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal geniş, düz ve açık alan niteliğine yönelir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yeryüzündeki geniş veya seçilebilir alanları anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal parçalanmış veya yönlenmiş bir arazi kesimidir; komşu dal açıklık ve genişlik niteliğini temel alır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal cins isim olarak arazi parçasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal belirli bir dağ veya yer adı olarak geçer.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da coğrafi alanla ilişkilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal tür adı olarak arazi kesimidir; komşu dal özel bir yer adıdır ve aynı anlam alanında tanımsal eşleşme kurmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; yer parçası, geniş arazi ve özel yer adı ayrımları en yararlı olanlardır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البين من الأرض: القطعة أو الناحية أو الغلظ من الأرض بقدر مد البصر.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أسماء المواضع المسماة بين أو مبين، ولا الوسط الظرفي بين شيئين.
branches.source_phrase_ar: البين قطعة من الأرض قدر مد البصر (maqayis)؛ البين الغلظ من الأرض (jamhara)؛ البين بالكسر القطعة من الأرض قدر منتهى البصر (sihah)؛ البين أيضا الناحية (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli beden, yay ve baş örneklerinde bir parçanın temas ettiği yerden ayrılması veya uzaklaşmasını verir. Geçici çerçeve bunu özel kalıplara bağlı tuttuğu sürece doğrudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnızca verilen cisimsel kalıplardaki ayrılma ve açıklıkla sınırlıdır; genel toplumsal ayrılık değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam kalıp kullanımına bağlıdır; tanım bu özel cisimsel örneklerden yalın kök anlamı üretmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli cisimsel kalıplarda bir organın, yayın teli gibi bir parçanın ya da başın bağlı olduğu yerden ayrılması, açılması veya koparılmasıdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam temas eden veya bağlı parçanın bulunduğu yerden ayrılmasıdır.
Hayvan uzvunun gövdeden açılması ve yay telinin gövdeden uzak durması örneklenir.
Başın gövdeden kesilip ayrılması aynı cisimsel koparma alanındadır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar belirli cisimsel örneklerde ayrılma çekirdeğini verir; bu çekirdek organ-gövde, tel-yay ve baş-gövde ilişkilerinde somutlaşır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Organ, tel veya baş gibi bir parçanın temas ettiği yerden ayrıldığı özel kalıplar için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Parçanın bağlı olduğu yerden ayrılması çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir uzvun gövdeye bitişik durmayıp yanından açıldığı bağlamda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Temas yerinden açılma anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Başın gövdeden kesilip ayrıldığı özel eylem bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kesip gövdeden ayırma anlamını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal özel organ, yay teli ve baş kalıplarıyla sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kesme ve koparma eylemini daha genel nesnelere uygular.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da parçanın bağlı olduğu yerden ayrılması alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal cisimsel örneklerle kayıtlıdır; komşu dal kesip ayırma işlemini daha genel verir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal belirli örneklerde ayrılıp açılma veya koparılmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir şeyi başka şeyden ayırma ve bütünden çıkarma işlemini geniş tutar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir parçanın ayrılmasını konu edinir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın kullanım alanı kalıplarla sınırlıdır; komşu dal aynı işlemi daha genel bir kesme-ayırma çekirdeğinde taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal cisimsel parça-temas ilişkilerinde özel ayrılmadır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal genel ayrılık ve kopuş anlamıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da ayrılma çekirdeği bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal özel nesne kalıplarını şart koşar; komşu dal ayrılmayı genel ve yalın biçimde anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; genel kesme ve yalın ayrılma komşuları en güçlü sınırları sağlar.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه بانت يد الناقة عن جنبها، والقوس البائنة التي بان وترها عن كبدها، وإبانة الرأس من الجسد.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sağma işindeki iki kişiden birini, özellikle hayvanın sol tarafından geleni belirtir. Geçici çerçeve bunu dar bir sağım terimi olarak tuttuğu için uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yalın görünse de anlam sağım alanındaki görev ve tarafla sınırlıdır; her ayrılan kişi anlamına gelmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam yalındır; tanım yine de kaynakta verilen teknik sağım rolünün dışına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Sağımda iki sağandan biri, özellikle hayvanın sol tarafından gelen sağan kişidir; karşısında sağ taraftan gelen eş sağan bulunur.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam sağım işindeki iki kişiden bir sağandır.
Bu sağan özellikle hayvanın sol tarafından gelen kişi olarak ayırt edilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sağımda iki kişilik rol ayrımını verir; bu dal o iki kişiden birini ve özellikle sol taraftan gelen sağanı karşı tarafındaki sağanla ayırır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sağımda hayvanın belirli yanından gelen sağan için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sağım rolünü ve sol yan ayırımını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yan bilgisinin önemli olmadığı ama teknik sağım rolünün açıklanması gereken yerlerde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sağım işindeki ikili rolü korur.
error_profile.loses: Sol taraftan gelme ayrıntısını açıkça vermez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: sağımda hayvanın sol yanından gelen sağan

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal sağım yapan kişinin teknik görev adıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal sol yan ve sol taraf kavramının kendisini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da sol taraf bilgisi kullanılır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal sol tarafı sağım rolünün ayırıcı şartı olarak kullanır; komşu dal sol tarafı bağımsız yön anlamı olarak verir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal sağım işindeki kişi ve konum rolünü adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal memedeki sütü tamamen sağma eylemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da sağım alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal eylemi yapan görevli kişiyi ayırır; komşu dal yapılan sağma işlemini çekirdek yapar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal sağan kişinin hangi taraftan geldiğini belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir hayvanın birden çok sağım kabına süt vermesi veya sağım duruşuyla ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal sağım sahnesinde yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal insan rolüdür; komşu dal sağılacak hayvanın durumuna ve süt akışına yönelir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; sol yön, sağma eylemi ve sağılacak hayvanla kurulan sınırlar yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البائن في الحلب: أحد الحالبين أو الذي يأتي الحلوبة من قبل شمالها مقابل المستعلي أو المعلى.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه كل فاعل مفارق أو كل بائن مطلقا، بل اصطلاح الحلب وحده.
branches.source_phrase_ar: البائن أحد الحالبين والآخر يسمى المستعلي (ayn)؛ البائن الذي يأتي الحلوبة من قبل شمالها والمعلى من قبل يمينها (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli biçimlerin zaman bağlacı gibi kullanılarak bir olayın başka bir durum sürerken gerçekleşmesini verdiğini gösterir. Geçici çerçeve bu zaman işlevini doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnızca zaman bağlacı işlevindeki biçimlerle sınırlıdır; yer aralığı veya genel orta anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam yalın olmayan biçimdedir; tanım yalnızca bu zaman bağlacı biçimlerini kapsar.

concept_map.definition: Bir durum veya eylem sürerken başka bir olayın gerçekleştiğini bildiren zaman bağlacı kullanımıdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam bir eylem veya durum sırasında başka olayın gerçekleşmesidir.
Bu işlev belirli biçimlerin zaman sözü gibi kullanılmasına bağlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalı zaman bağlacı işleviyle açıklar; biçim, bir olayın bekleme veya başka bir sürmekte olan durum içinde gerçekleşmesini bildirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir olayın başka bir eylem veya durum devam ederken gerçekleştiği zaman bağlacı bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sürmekte olan durum içindeki zaman ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir olayın başka bir bekleme veya gözleme durumu sırasında geliştiği anlatımlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sürmekte olan eylem sırasında gerçekleşme anlamını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal şeyin genel vakti veya uygun zamanı anlamındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da zaman ve vaktin bildirilmesi alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal olaylar arası eşzamanlılık bağlacı olarak çalışır; komşu dal bağımsız zaman veya vakit adıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da zaman belirleme alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal cümle bağlayan eşzamanlılık işlevindedir; komşu dal daha genel zaman adı olarak kalır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal zaman içinde olma bağlacı olarak kullanılır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yer veya ilişki bakımından arada olmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da aralık fikri tarihsel veya kavramsal bir köprü kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal aralığı zamansal cümle ilişkisine çevirir; komşu dal mekansal veya topluluksal ara konumda kalır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli tekrar biçiminde iki uç arasında kalan ara durumları, ayrıca zayıf ve dikkate alınmaz düşmeyi verir. Geçici çerçeve bunu kalıba bağlı orta hal olarak doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnızca tekrar biçimindeki ara-hal kullanımıdır; genel ara konum dalıyla özdeş değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam yalın olmayan biçimdedir; tanım tekrar kalıbının ara ve zayıf hal kullanımıyla sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: İki uç değer arasında kalan ara veya orta haldir; kimi örneklerde bu aralık zayıflık ve hesaba katılmama olarak görünür.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam iki uç arasında kalan orta veya ara haldir.
İyi ile kötü arasında olma veya sesin iki söyleyiş arasında kalması örneklenir.
Ara hal kimi kullanımda zayıf ve hesaba katılmaz düşme sonucuna kayar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu dal tek kaynakta tekrar biçimine bağlı olarak orta hal, dilsel ara ses ve zayıf düşme örnekleriyle açıklanır.

source_details.summary: Tek kaynak bu kalıbı iki uç arasında kalma, dilde ara telaffuz ve zayıf düşme örnekleriyle verir.

error_profile.preserves: Ara hal, iki uç arasında kalma ve zayıflama yönünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin değer bakımından iki uç arasında kaldığı günlük anlatım için uygundur.

error_profile.loses: Dilsel ara telaffuz ve zayıf düşme örneklerini kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel ara-hal kalıbıdır; komşu dal yaş ve olgunluk evresine özgüdür.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal nitelik veya durum bakımından iki uç arasında kalır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da aradalık fikrini taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de yönetme gücü ve toplumsal üstünlük alanında buluşur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi artma, çoğalma, bereket ve uğurlu çoğalış alanını birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve bu büyüme çekirdeğini doğru taşır ve yönetim, buyruk veya belirti anlamlarına geçmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek bolluk ve verimli çoğalmadır; makam, buyruk ve işaret anlamları dışarıda kalır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, sayıca veya varlıkça artma ve çoğalmadır.
Artış, mal, soy, doğurganlık ve uğurluluk bağlamlarında verimli bereket olarak genişler.

error_profile.loses: Uğur ve bereket değerini açık taşımaz.

error_profile.preserves: Verimli uğurluluk yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Düz sayısal çoğalmayı her bağlamda açık belirtmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirti, yol izi, küçük yol taşı ve belirlenmiş zaman ya da randevu anlamlarını aynı dalda verir. Geçici çerçeve hem gösterge hem belirlenmiş vakit yönünü korur ve buyruk ya da yönetim anlamını dışarıda bırakır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Belirti, yol işareti ve belirlenmiş zaman alanıdır; buyruk ve yönetim anlamı değildir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, bir şeyi tanıtan veya gösteren belirti ve işarettir.
Yol veya çöl içindeki küçük taş işaretleri bu belirti anlamının özel bağlamıdır.
Belirlenmiş zaman veya randevu da bu dalda verilen ayrı bir kapsamdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar belirti ve yol işareti anlamını ortak biçimde verir; aynı dal içinde belirlenmiş zaman veya buluşma vaktine uzanan kullanım da bulunur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi şaşırtıcı, ağır, büyük ve yadırganan işi anlatır; bazı açıklamalar bunu büyük kötülük veya tuhaflık olarak açar. Geçici çerçeve bu şiddetli yadırganma çekirdeğini doğru verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi başkasıyla danışmayı, topluluğun kendi arasında görüş alışverişini, kişinin kendi içinde tartıp karar bağlamasını ve görüş kabulünü birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve bu danışma ve karar oluşturma alanını doğru yansıtır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin başka bir şeyden sonra gelmesini onun görevini üstlenme ve yerini doldurma şartına bağlar. Aile veya topluluk içinde başkasının işini yürütme ile kaybın karşılanması bu çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başka bir şeyden sonra gelerek onun yerini, görevini veya işlevini üstlenmesidir. Bir kimsenin ailesinin işlerini yürütme ve yitirilenin yerine karşılık sağlama, belirli yapılara bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Sonradan gelen, öncekinin yerini veya işlevini üstlenir.

Yitirilen bir şeyin yerine denk bir karşılık verilmesi, yalnızca ilgili kalıplarda görülen uzantıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda sıra ilişkisi yerini tutma veya işi üstlenmeyle tamamlanır; komşu dal ise aynı işlevi devralmayan sıradan ardışıklık ve dönüşümlere de uzanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kişiler dışındaki şeylerin yer değiştirmesini ve kaybın karşılanmasını da kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Özellikle hükümdar, topluluk görevi ve yardımcılar içindeki makam veya sıra ilişkisine bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: genel yerine geçme ile makam ardıllığı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da bir kimse başkasının ardından gelip onun görevini üstlenebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal genel bir ardından gelme ve yerini tutma bağı kurar; komşu dal bunu yönetim, makam veya yardımcılar arasındaki görev sırasına daraltır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sonradan gelenin öncekinin yerini veya işlevini üstlenmesi gerekir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İki veya daha çok öğenin sırayla gelip gitmesi ve birbirini izlemesi yeterlidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir öğe başka bir öğeden sonra gelir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Yerine geçme dalı işlevsel devralmayı öne çıkarır; dönüşüm dalı ise görev devri olmaksızın nöbetleşmeyi veya düzenli ardışıklığı anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir ardılın öncekinin yerini veya görevini üstlenmesini genel ilişki olarak anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kaybolan bitki, meyve, tüy veya malın ardından yenisinin ortaya çıkmasına bağlanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da önceki bir şeyin ardından onun yerini dolduran başka bir şey bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yerini tutan ardılın işlevine odaklanır; komşu dal kayıptan sonra yeniden çıkma, yenilenme veya karşılık bulma olayına odaklanır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; yalnız yerini tutma çekirdeğini genel ardışıklık, makam ardıllığı, dönüşüm ve yenilenmeden ayıran dört karşılaştırma yayıma değer bulundu.
